decision: Read layouts via GET /my-charts/ + /chart/<id>/json/ and drawings via charts-storage buckets 1..n, _shared, user/sources
why: Same calls the web app makes; drawings moved out of layout content in 2022
evidence: bundle 3233 module 908862; bundle 16242 modules 355502/628770; smolkin.org write-up

decision: Run all TradingView requests inside a hidden tradingview.com page (Electron partition)
why: Exact cookies/origin/headers of the web app; no cookie decryption; one place to enforce host allow-list
evidence: pageFetch/pageUser serialized via executeJavaScript

decision: Restore = POST /api/v1/charts/save/ without image_url, drawings inlined into content
why: One request, never touches existing layouts; ChartSaver writes this format itself when storage is down and the loader reads it
evidence: Injected 11 drawings via loadLayoutState: TradingView rendered all (test/fixtures/tradingview-reference.png)

decision: No web-UI restore fallback
why: Autosave in a driven chart page could overwrite the open layout
evidence: ChartSaver autosave code path in bundle 95474

decision: Fetch indicator values from TradingView (create_study) instead of computing locally
why: Faithful for every indicator incl. private Pine; local formulas cover only a few
evidence: Captured page frames: Script@tv-scripting-101! with text/pineId/pineVersion and {v,f,t} inputs; test asserts byte-equal request

decision: Sign-in in the user's own Chrome/Edge via --remote-debugging-pipe, then copy cookies into the app session and delete the temp profile
why: Google refuses sign-in in embedded browsers; pipe opens no network port
evidence: test/main/browserSignIn.test.ts with real Chromium

decision: Electron over Tauri
why: One bundled Chromium = same rendering and behavior on Win/macOS/Linux; Node for the TradingView client; electron-builder makes exe/dmg/AppImage/deb
evidence: Tauri uses WebView2/WKWebView/WebKitGTK

decision: Snapshot written to .in-progress-<stamp>, renamed on success, <stamp>-INCOMPLETE on failure
why: A partial backup must never look complete
evidence: test/core/snapshot.test.ts, backup-restore.test.ts

decision: Restore journal with pre-recorded planned name
why: A lost save answer or crash must not create a second copy on retry
evidence: test "adopts the layout when the answer to the save was lost"

decision: Reference fixture built by loading a known layout into signed-out TradingView
why: No account available; gives a real TradingView screenshot of the same layout for the viewer check
evidence: scripts/capture-reference.ts

decision: Signed-out sessions cannot compute Pine-based or BB studies (study_limit_exceeded) -> reference uses MA + RSI
why: TradingView itself shows ! on those when signed out
evidence: tradingview-reference.png earlier capture
result: live test covers Pine with an account

decision: Fix 15 findings from an independent review
why: Two broke hard requirements: partial drawings marked complete; a second confirmed replace silently did nothing
evidence: review report; new tests for each

decision: Daily schedule: due when no success since the most recent chosen hour; 3 h back-off after a failure
why: Old rule never caught up in the morning and retried a failing backup every 15 min
evidence: test/main/schedule.test.ts

decision: Restore counts as verified only when TradingView itself shows every drawing
why: The read-back alone only proves what was stored
evidence: src/main/main.ts doRestore
result: UI shows "could not check" when the chart page check fails

decision: Restore verdict computed once, in core (checkRestore), with the chart-page count injected
why: main, core and the window applied three different rules; a page showing extra drawings got a warning banner over an all-green table
evidence: test/core/backup-restore.test.ts verification tests

decision: Thermo-nuclear quality review: typed layout content, core owns snapshot loading/compare and the restore verdict, typed IPC, main.ts split, structured diff wording
why: Two blockers: untyped content with drifting rules (latent numeric chartId bug) and domain logic in untestable main.ts
evidence: /tmp/chartkeeper-thermo/quality; commits ad38cfc..f3030a7

decision: Content model kept permissive for sources
why: One odd source must not fail a whole backup or stop old backups opening (refactor review finding)
evidence: test "keeps a layout with an odd indicator or a numeric id readable"

decision: Thermo-nuclear audit: page calls time out and fail when their page closes; sign-out and restore targets take the busy lock
why: Sign out during a backup hung the app forever and silently stopped daily backups
evidence: Electron probe: closed page rejects in ~1 s

decision: Snapshot files compared case-insensitively and read back before a backup is called complete
why: Two Pine scripts differing only in case overwrote each other on Windows/macOS
evidence: tests in snapshot.test.ts and backup-restore.test.ts

decision: Remove Replace; one write policy (four creates, exact URL, closed field lists) checked in PoliteHttp and in the session's onBeforeRequest; template and theme names checked right before each add
why: The user's requirement: ChartKeeper must never change or delete an existing TradingView chart, restore included. TradingView's own chart page can autosave over a layout ChartKeeper opens
evidence: Electron 44 probe: onBeforeRequest fires for protocol.handle requests and cancel stops them; fetch(FormData of strings) arrives as one bytes part, a Blob part has no bytes. Mutation checks in neverChangesTradingView.test.ts

decision: Session lets a write out only when ChartKeeper registered it for its own page's webContents, once
why: The policy alone let TradingView's own page code send an allowed create, such as a template under a taken name, which overwrites it (review finding)
evidence: tests in sessionPolicy.test.ts with mutation checks; e2e chart page tries five writes and reports each cancelled (not run locally)

decision: Restored name carries local date and time to the minute; journal records the layouts that existed before the save
why: Two restores on one day shared a name, so resuming the second could adopt the first copy (review finding)
evidence: tests in backup-restore.test.ts with mutation checks

decision: A drawing point's offset counts trading days (or bars) of the point's own interval; past the last intraday bar exchange holidays are skipped
why: A user's SILJ layout drawn on 1D and saved on 5m showed notes and waves days off in the viewer: TradingView keeps points placed past the last bar as that bar plus an offset in daily bars
evidence: TradingView's 5m chart put Oct 13 - 10 D on Sep 29, Sep 21 - 16 D on Aug 27 (Labor Day not counted), Oct 19 13:30 + 12 x 60 on Oct 20 18:30; projections into 2027 matched only once session_holidays were skipped; gallery scene replica-silj-daily-drawings-on-5m

decision: README.txt in each snapshot folder and next to snapshots/, written outside the manifest's file list
why: A user who opened his backup folder could not tell where the backup was or which layouts/<uid> folder held which layout. Outside the file list, verify and listSnapshots never see it
evidence: tests in readme.test.ts and snapshot.test.ts
